cant_connect.description: Turn off all booleans which allow domain connect to any network port

booleans.name: cluster_can_network_connect
booleans.comment: Allow cluster administrative domains to connect to the network using TCP.

booleans.name: cobbler_can_network_connect
booleans.comment: Determine whether Cobbler can connect to the network using TCP.

booleans.name: collectd_tcp_network_connect
booleans.comment: Determine whether collectd can connect to the network using TCP.

booleans.name: conman_can_network
booleans.comment: Determine whether conman can connect to all TCP ports

booleans.name: condor_tcp_network_connect
booleans.comment: Determine whether Condor can connect to the network using TCP.

booleans.name: exim_can_connect_db
booleans.comment: Determine whether exim can connect to databases.

booleans.name: fenced_can_network_connect
booleans.comment: Determine whether fenced can connect to the TCP network.

booleans.name: ftpd_connect_all_unreserved
booleans.comment: Determine whether ftpd can connect to all unreserved ports.

booleans.name: ftpd_use_passive_mode
booleans.comment: Determine whether ftpd can bind to all unreserved ports for passive mode.

booleans.name: ftpd_connect_db
booleans.comment: Determine whether ftpd can connect to databases over the TCP network.

booleans.name: git_session_bind_all_unreserved_ports
booleans.comment: Determine whether Git session daemon can bind TCP sockets to all unreserved ports.

booleans.name: glance_api_can_network
booleans.comment: Determine whether glance-api can connect to all TCP ports

booleans.name: haproxy_connect_any
booleans.comment: Determine whether haproxy can connect to all TCP ports.

booleans.name: httpd_can_connect_ftp
booleans.comment: Allow httpd to act as a FTP client connecting to the ftp port and ephemeral ports

booleans.name: httpd_can_connect_ldap
booleans.comment: Allow httpd to connect to the ldap port

booleans.name: httpd_can_connect_mythtv
booleans.comment: Allow http daemon to connect to mythtv

booleans.name: httpd_can_connect_zabbix
booleans.comment: Allow http daemon to connect to zabbix

booleans.name: httpd_can_network_connect
booleans.comment: Allow HTTPD scripts and modules to connect to the network using TCP.

booleans.name: httpd_can_network_connect_cobbler
booleans.comment: Allow HTTPD scripts and modules to connect to cobbler over the network.

booleans.name: httpd_can_network_connect_db
booleans.comment: Allow HTTPD scripts and modules to connect to databases over the network.

booleans.name: httpd_can_network_memcache
booleans.comment: Allow httpd to connect to memcache server

booleans.name: httpd_can_network_relay
booleans.comment: Allow httpd to act as a relay

booleans.name: httpd_enable_ftp_server
booleans.comment: Allow httpd to act as a FTP server by listening on the ftp port.

booleans.name: httpd_graceful_shutdown
booleans.comment: Allow HTTPD to connect to port 80 for graceful shutdown

booleans.name: httpd_use_openstack
booleans.comment: Allow httpd to access openstack ports

booleans.name: httpd_use_sasl
booleans.comment: Allow httpd to connect to sasl

booleans.name: icecast_use_any_tcp_ports
booleans.comment: Determine whether icecast can listen on and connect to any TCP port.

booleans.name: irc_use_any_tcp_ports
booleans.comment: Determine whether irc clients can listen on and connect to any unreserved TCP ports.

booleans.name: irssi_use_full_network
booleans.comment: Allow the Irssi IRC Client to connect to any port, and to bind to any unreserved port.

booleans.name: keepalived_connect_any
booleans.comment: Determine whether keepalived can connect to all TCP ports.

booleans.name: logwatch_can_network_connect_mail
booleans.comment: Determine whether logwatch can connect to mail over the network.

booleans.name: lsmd_plugin_connect_any
booleans.comment: Determine whether lsmd_plugin can connect to all TCP ports.

booleans.name: mozilla_plugin_bind_unreserved_ports
booleans.comment: Allow mozilla plugin domain to bind unreserved tcp/udp ports.

booleans.name: mozilla_plugin_can_network_connect
booleans.comment: Allow mozilla plugin domain to connect to the network using TCP.

booleans.name: mysql_connect_any
booleans.comment: Allow mysqld to connect to all ports

booleans.name: mysql_connect_http
booleans.comment: Allow mysqld to connect to http port

booleans.name: named_tcp_bind_http_port
booleans.comment: Determine whether Bind can bind tcp socket to http ports.

booleans.name: neutron_can_network
booleans.comment: Determine whether neutron can connect to all TCP ports

booleans.name: openfortivpn_can_network_connect
booleans.comment: Determine whether openfortivpn can connect to the TCP network.

booleans.name: openvpn_can_network_connect
booleans.comment: Determine whether openvpn can connect to the TCP network.

booleans.name: pcp_bind_all_unreserved_ports
booleans.comment: Allow pcp to bind to all unreserved_ports

booleans.name: pdns_can_network_connect_db
booleans.comment: Allow PowerDNS to connect to databases over the network.

booleans.name: piranha_lvs_can_network_connect
booleans.comment: Allow piranha-lvs domain to connect to the network using TCP.

booleans.name: polipo_session_bind_all_unreserved_ports
booleans.comment: Determine whether Polipo session daemon can bind tcp sockets to all unreserved ports.

booleans.name: polipo_connect_all_unreserved
booleans.comment: Allow polipo to connect to all ports > 1023

booleans.name: privoxy_connect_any
booleans.comment: Determine whether privoxy can connect to all tcp ports.

booleans.name: prosody_bind_http_port
booleans.comment: Permit to prosody to bind apache port. Need to be activated to use BOSH.

booleans.name: samba_portmapper
booleans.comment: Allow samba to act as a portmapper

booleans.name: selinuxuser_mysql_connect_enabled
booleans.comment: Allow users to connect to the local mysql server

booleans.name: selinuxuser_postgresql_connect_enabled
booleans.comment: Allow users to connect to PostgreSQL

booleans.name: selinuxuser_tcp_server
booleans.comment: Allow users to run TCP servers (bind to ports and accept connection from the same domain and outside users) disabling this forces FTP passive mode and may change other protocols.

booleans.name: selinuxuser_udp_server
booleans.comment: Allow users to run UDP servers (bind to ports and accept connection from the same domain and outside users) disabling this may break avahi discovering services on the network and other udp related services.

booleans.name: sge_domain_can_network_connect
booleans.comment: Allow sge to connect to the network using any TCP port

booleans.name: spamassassin_can_network
booleans.comment: Allow user spamassassin clients to use the network.

booleans.name: spamd_update_can_network
booleans.comment: Allow spamd_update to connect to all ports.

booleans.name: squid_bind_snmp_port
booleans.comment: Determine whether squid should have access to snmp port.

booleans.name: squid_connect_any
booleans.comment: Determine whether squid can connect to all TCP ports.

booleans.name: sssd_connect_all_unreserved_ports
booleans.comment: Allow sssd connect to all unreserved ports

booleans.name: sslh_can_bind_any_port
booleans.comment: Determine whether sslh can listen on any tcp port or if it is restricted to the standard http.

booleans.name: sslh_can_connect_any_port
booleans.comment: Determine whether sslh can connect to any tcp port or if it is restricted to the standard http, openvpn and jabber ports.

booleans.name: swift_can_network
booleans.comment: Determine whether swift can connect to all TCP ports

booleans.name: systemd_socket_proxyd_connect_any
booleans.comment: Allow systemd-socket-proxyd to connect to any port instead of labelled ones.

booleans.name: telepathy_connect_all_ports
booleans.comment: Allow the Telepathy connection managers to connect to any network port.

booleans.name: telepathy_tcp_connect_generic_network_ports
booleans.comment: Allow the Telepathy connection managers to connect to any generic TCP port.

booleans.name: tomcat_can_network_connect_db
booleans.comment: Allow tomcat to connect to databases over the network.

booleans.name: tor_bind_all_unreserved_ports
booleans.comment: Determine whether tor can bind tcp sockets to all unreserved ports.

booleans.name: tor_can_network_relay
booleans.comment: Allow tor to act as a relay

booleans.name: varnishd_connect_any
booleans.comment: Determine whether varnishd can use the full TCP network.

booleans.name: virt_use_comm
booleans.comment: Allow confined virtual guests to use serial/parallel communication ports

booleans.name: xdm_bind_vnc_tcp_port
booleans.comment: Allows xdm_t to bind on vnc_port_t

booleans.name: zabbix_can_network
booleans.comment: Determine whether zabbix can connect to all TCP ports

deny_execmem.description: Turn off all booleans which allow domain execmem/execstack

booleans.name: boinc_execmem
booleans.comment: Determine whether boinc can execmem/execstack.

booleans.name: cluster_use_execmem
booleans.comment: Allow cluster administrative cluster domains memcheck-amd64- to use executable memory

booleans.name: cups_execmem
booleans.comment: Allow cups execmem/execstack

booleans.name: deny_execmem
booleans.comment: Deny user domains applications to map a memory region as both executable and writable

booleans.name: deny_ptrace
booleans.comment: Deny any process from ptracing or debugging any other processes.

booleans.name: glance_use_execmem
booleans.comment: Allow glance domain to use executable memory and executable stack

booleans.name: gluster_use_execmem
booleans.comment: Allow glusterd_t domain to use executable memory

booleans.name: httpd_execmem
booleans.comment: Allow httpd scripts and modules execmem/execstack

booleans.name: mplayer_execstack
booleans.comment: Determine whether mplayer can make its stack executable

booleans.name: rngd_execmem
booleans.comment: Allow rngd_t domain to use executable memory

booleans.name: selinuxuser_execheap
booleans.comment: Allow unconfined executables to make their heap memory executable. Doing this is a really bad idea. Probably indicates a badly coded executable, but could indicate an attack. This executable should be reported in bugzilla

booleans.name: selinuxuser_execmod
booleans.comment: Allow all unconfined executables to use libraries requiring text relocation that are not labeled textrel_shlib_t

booleans.name: selinuxuser_execstack
booleans.comment: Allow unconfined executables to make their stack executable. This should never, ever be necessary. Probably indicates a badly coded executable, but could indicate an attack. This executable should be reported in bugzilla

booleans.name: tomcat_use_execmem
booleans.comment: Allow tomcat to use executable memory and executable stack

booleans.name: virt_use_execmem
booleans.comment: Allow confined virtual guests to use executable memory and executable stack

booleans.name: xserver_execmem
booleans.comment: Allows XServer to execute writable memory

booleans.name: gluster_anon_write
booleans.comment: Gluster ###

booleans.name: gluster_export_all_rw
booleans.comment: Allow glusterfsd to share any file/directory read/write

booleans.name: gluster_export_all_ro
booleans.comment: Allow glusterfsd to share any file/directory read only.

booleans.name: nfsd_anon_write
booleans.comment: NFS ###

booleans.name: nfs_export_all_rw
booleans.comment: Allow nfs to export all read/write

booleans.name: nfs_export_all_ro
booleans.comment: Allow nfs to export all read only.

booleans.name: rsync_export_all_ro
booleans.comment: Rsync ###

booleans.name: smbd_anon_write
booleans.comment: Samba ###

booleans.name: samba_enable_home_dirs
booleans.comment: Allow samba to share users home directories.

booleans.name: samba_export_all_rw
booleans.comment: Allow samba to export all read/write

booleans.name: samba_export_all_ro
booleans.comment: Allow samba to export all read only.

booleans.name: samba_share_fusefs
booleans.comment: Allow samba to export ntfs/fusefs volumes.

booleans.name: samba_share_nfs
booleans.comment: Allow samba to export NFS volumes.

booleans.name: unconfined
booleans.comment: Unconfined domains run with no or few restrictions but do not log any requested access

booleans.name: permissivedomains
booleans.comment: Permissive domains are individual domains that are specified to run in permissive mode and log access what would be denied
